heading: Friday, December 20, 2024
topLine: OpenAI reports o3 solves 25.2% of FrontierMath problems.

items.headline: OpenAI reports o3 solves 25.2% of FrontierMath problems
items.summary: When OpenAI announced o3, it reported a 25.2% score on Epoch AI's FrontierMath benchmark of hard research-style problems. Previous models had scored about 2%. The score was self-reported. It later emerged that OpenAI had funded the benchmark and had access to many of its problems. In April 2025, Epoch's independent test of the released o3 found about 10%, on a different problem set and setup.

image.alt: Bar chart of FrontierMath accuracy: previous state of the art 2.0% vs o3 25.2%
